A collection of resources for research, teaching, and academic life at [Georgia State University](https://www.gsu.edu/), together with career resources I find useful.

# Research

- [GSU Library databases](https://research.library.gsu.edu/az/databases) — find literature and subject databases through the university library.
- [Research Data Services](https://library.gsu.edu/get-help/data-services/) — consultations and training in R, Python, data analysis, visualization, data management, and AI in research.
- [Interlibrary Loan](https://library.gsu.edu/borrowing-services/interlibrary-loan/) — request articles and books that are not available in GSU's collections.
- [University Research Services & Administration (URSA)](https://ursa.research.gsu.edu/) — research support, proposal and award administration, training, and access to research systems.

# Computing

For cluster access, storage, and R or Python batch jobs, see my [GSU research computing guide](/resources/gsu_computing/).

- [ARCTIC](https://arctic.gsu.edu/) — GSU's advanced research computing services and infrastructure.
- [Elpis](https://elpis.rs.gsu.edu/) — manage research projects, computing allocations, project membership, and SSH certificates.
- [Hemera / Open OnDemand](https://hemera.rs.gsu.edu/) — access files, interactive applications, and cluster jobs through a browser.
- [ARCTIC documentation](https://arcwiki.rs.gsu.edu/) — instructions for access, Slurm jobs, software, storage, and data transfer.
- [ARCTIC consulting](https://arctic.gsu.edu/consulting/) — help with research software, parallel computing, performance, and scaling workflows beyond a laptop.
- [ARCTIC workshops](https://elpis.rs.gsu.edu/workshops/) — training in cluster use and scientific computing; sign in to register.
- [GSU Technology Help](https://gsutech.service-now.com/sp) — the university's IT service portal for general technology support.
- [SAS OnDemand for Academics](https://welcome.oda.sas.com/) — browser-based SAS access through a separate SAS account.
- [sites@gsu](https://sites.gsu.edu/) — GSU-hosted websites; [my GSU site](https://sites.gsu.edu/cyeh/) is one example.

# Grants and funding {#grant}

- [Find funding / Pivot-RP](https://ursa.research.gsu.edu/research-development/find-funding/) — search funding opportunities, save searches, and explore potential collaborators using GSU's institutional access.
- [GSU InfoReady](https://gsu.infoready4.com/) — internal funding competitions and applications; consult each opportunity's instructions.
- [Grantseeker and proposal resources](https://ursa.research.gsu.edu/research-development/grantseeker-resources/) — proposal-development materials, workshops, and resources for early-career researchers.
- [Brains & Behavior seed grants](https://neuroscience.gsu.edu/brains-behavior/seed-grants/) — support for neuroscience and behavior research. The posted 2026 application deadline was February 23, 2026; use the program page for future calls.
- [NVIDIA Academic Grant Program](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/industries/higher-education-research/academic-grant-program/) — external research support; current calls specify eligible topics, resources, and application dates.

# Teaching and training

- [CETLOE](https://cetloe.gsu.edu/) — teaching consultations, course design, instructional technology, workshops, and teaching-related funding opportunities.
- [iCollege](https://icollege.gsu.edu/) — GSU's learning management system for course materials, assignments, and communication.
- [Library instruction and workshops](https://library.gsu.edu/get-help/library-instruction-and-workshops/) — library instruction and research-skills training for courses and individual researchers.
- [Academic calendar](https://registrar.gsu.edu/registration/semester-calendars-exam-schedules/) — semester dates and exam schedules from the Office of the Registrar.

# Faculty

- [Faculty resources](https://faculty.gsu.edu/faculty-resources/) — a central directory of faculty services, information systems, policies, and professional support.
- [New faculty orientation and onboarding](https://faculty.gsu.edu/for-new-faculty/) — orientation information and the current onboarding checklist.
- [Faculty Handbook](https://faculty.gsu.edu/faculty-handbook/) — university faculty policies and resources.
- [College of Arts & Sciences tenure-track guide](https://cas.gsu.edu/faculty-review-services/tenure-track-faculty/) — college guidance for tenure-track faculty reviews.
- [Promotion, tenure, and review](https://faculty.gsu.edu/ptr/) — manuals, calendars, process information, and forms; some materials require GSU sign-in.
- [Digital Measures / Faculty Success](https://faculty.gsu.edu/digitalmeasures/) — record and report teaching, research, and service activities.

# Career development and further reading

## Job boards {#some-job-boards}

- [University Affairs](https://universityaffairs.ca/search-jobs/) — Canadian academic positions across disciplines.
- [Canadian Mathematical Society careers](https://cms.math.ca/careers/).
- [Statistical Society of Canada employment listings](https://ssc.ca/en/employment).
- [MathJobs](https://www.mathjobs.org/) — mathematics and related academic positions.

## Canadian machine-learning institutes {#canadian-machine-learning-centres}

- [Mila — Quebec Artificial Intelligence Institute](https://mila.quebec/en).

Updated September 26, 2026. GSU service descriptions were checked against the linked official pages.
